svg.text: Housing.com Property Search Database — ER Diagram (Team T0079, crow’s foot notation)
12 tables in schema “housing”. project_amenities and shortlists are bridge tables implementing M:N relationships. properties.project_id is nullable (0..1): standalone houses, villas and plots.
‖ exactly one χ‖ zero or one crow’s foot + χ = zero or many
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UK = unique key e.g. LOCALITIES ‖—o{ PROPERTIES : each property is in exactly one locality; a locality has many properties
